title: Autonomous Inbound Email Triage & Routing (20 Fields)
description: Real-time classification of an inbound email to determine destination team, spam or phishing risk, reply priority, and response workflow.
context:
INBOUND EMAIL #EMAIL-48207
From: jennifer.morrison@acme-corp.com (Recognized customer, Account ID: ACME-3391, ARR: 0k)
To: contact@yourcompany.com (general inbox, no team alias)
Received: 2026-09-20 08:47 UTC (Monday, business hours EMEA)
Subject: Re: Renewal quote Q-9921 — contract renewal question + invoice discrepancy
Thread Type: Follow-up reply to prior renewal thread (in-reply-to: <renewal-Q-9921@yourcompany.com>)
Attachments: invoice_INV-202609-0044.pdf (scanned PDF, 240KB)
Account Plan: Enterprise (strategic tier, dedicated CSM: David Park)
SLA Contract: Enterprise response SLA = 4 business hours for billing+renewal combined queries.

Body: Hi team,

Our renewal is coming up next month and I had two quick items:

1. The renewal quote (Q-9921) shows 12% uplift but our CSM promised a price-lock through 2026. Can someone from sales confirm the correct pricing before we sign?

2. Invoice INV-202609-0044 for ,200 does not match our PO (,400). The line item for 'Premium Support Add-on' was not authorized. We need this corrected before we can process payment.

We need this resolved by end of week or we will need to escalate to our procurement team. Please route to the right person.

Thanks,
Jennifer Morrison
VP Operations, Acme Corp

destination.description: Primary internal team the email should be routed to

is_spam_or_phishing.description: Whether the email is unsolicited spam or a phishing attempt

priority.description: Reply and handling urgency on an ordered scale

needs_reply.description: Whether a human or automated reply must be sent to the sender

secondary_destination.description: Secondary team to CC or coordinate with

contains_billing_dispute.description: Whether the email raises an invoice or billing discrepancy requiring finance action

contains_renewal_question.description: Whether the email asks about contract renewal terms or pricing

requires_csm_involvement.description: Whether the Customer Success Manager must be looped in

auto_reply_eligible.description: Whether an automated acknowledgment reply can be sent without human review

escalate_to_manager.description: Whether the case must be escalated to a team manager

sla_deadline_hours.description: Target response window on an ordered scale from fastest to most relaxed

contains_pii.description: Whether the email body contains personally identifiable information requiring redaction

contains_attachment.description: Whether the email has an attachment requiring malware scanning

assign_to_queue.description: Whether the email should be assigned to a named agent queue rather than auto-resolved

contains_legal_language.description: Whether the email contains legal threats or contract-citation language requiring legal review

account_health_impact.description: Whether the email signals an account-health risk
